# Paths enforced by run-clang-format.sh / run-clang-format.ps1.
#
# INCREMENTAL ALLOWLIST. The format gate used to target a nonexistent `soh/`
# directory and so formatted nothing — it passed vacuously for the whole life
# of the repo (fixed in c2834780). Turning it on for all of games/oot +
# games/mm at once would reformat ~1050 vendored decomp files (~11.6k lines),
# which is both unreviewable and permanent conflict surface against the
# upstream SoH / 2Ship trees we track.
#
# So the gate is enforced on an explicit list that grows incrementally.
# Seeded with the files touched by the phase-2 cross-game work. Expanding it
# to the rest of the tree is tracked as a separate issue — add paths here as
# directories are cleaned up, one reviewable batch at a time.
#
# Deliberately NOT listed: vendored decomp files whose only RSBS change is a
# one-line #include, where whole-file reformatting costs far more in upstream
# conflicts than it buys (e.g. games/mm/src/code/z_bgcheck.c would take 174
# reformatted lines to justify a single #include).
#
# One path per line. Blank lines and #-comments ignored. Every listed path
# must exist — a stale entry is a hard error, so this list cannot silently
# rot into another vacuous gate.

games/mm/2s2h/BenPort.h
